messages:
sara: Quick sync — plan to enable the new console hidden-settings flag for a limited beta tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: validate guardrails and telemetry before wider exposure.

kevin: Timeline noted. Who's running the canary audience selection? we should avoid large orgs or high-traffic tenants.

sara: Canary = 10 orgs: 6 internal (eng/product/support) + 4 opt-ins from the beta signup list. I've pinned the org IDs in the doc: https://drive.google.com/... :link:

matt: Ping @kevin for a quick review of the frontend changes. PR #4321 contains the feature flag checks and a server-side kill switch.

kevin: I'll review this morning. Two asks: 1) add a fallback route for non-flagged users so they don't hit a 404, 2) include a tag on telemetry for variant=A/B.

olga: For analytics, we'll emit `console.beta.hidden_settings_shown` with props: org_id, user_role, variant, timestamp. I'll add the schema entry and wire it in.

flagbot: Flag staging update: `console.ui.hidden_settings` set to rollout plan: manual -> canary 10 orgs -> ramp 0% to 100% over 48h if guardrails pass. Current rollout: 0%.

sara: Important: do NOT start auto-ramp until `guardrails.all_green` is true. We'll manually flip the canary to 10 orgs, observe 2 full cycles, then allow ramp.

matt: Ops check: is there a dashboard that surfaces latency/error for the routes touched by this UI? If errors >2x baseline or latency +50%, auto-kill the flag.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: `console-frontend` v2.14.3 -> target 10 orgs, 10% traffic for those orgs. CI run: https://ci.redwood.internal/deploy/789 :rocket:

kevin: Left a couple of small comments on the PR about unit tests and a guard test that asserts support agents don't see the hidden settings. Can someone add an e2e?

sara: I'll add the e2e to the checklist and create a short test plan. Also drafting the beta comms blurb for marketing. @alice can you review when I post it? Need a short opt-out link and a one-line description.

alice: Happy to review — please include the known limitations (mobile layout, limited search results) and the opt-out URL. I'll coordinate a short help-center note.

matt: I'll be watching the metrics around 09:15 PT and will post a summary here. If anything looks off, we kill the flag and roll back the deploy. :eyes:

sara: Thanks team — checklist below for clarity:
- canary orgs set (done)
- PR merged with kill switch & telemetry (in review)
- analytics schema updated (olga)
- dashboard & alert thresholds configured (matt/ops)
- comms draft reviewed (alice)
- manual flip only after `guardrails.all_green`

sara: If you have objections or additional guardrails, reply here and we'll postpone. Otherwise I'll flip the canary at 09:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
